Statuses a skill can leave on an enemy (design/05 Appendix B, Brent 2026-10-12; the 2026-10-22 drafts). All of it is ours [MODEL]. One general engine reads these keys in one place (enemy.gd, the '# --- the status engine' block): stacks (max), lasts (s; refreshed when applied again unless no_refresh), move_mult / speed_mult, move_mult_per_stack, attack_speed_mult / attack_rate_mult, windup_mult, cannot_act, cannot_attack, cannot_move, immovable, no_call, dps_per_stack / dps_per_metal_class every tick_s through whoever applied it (dot_tags, moving_mult, times_flesh, dps_mult), damage_taken_mult (damage_taken_except tags, damage_taken_from affinities), armour_mult (+ _per_stack), front_block_off, counts_rear, deals_mult, no_poise_damage, poise_regen_off, poise_max_mult, poise_per_s, nudge_per_s, spread_radius / spread_time, jumps_on_death, on_expire {status | damage_per_stack}, on_cap {status, clear, elite_status}, on_death {pool, held_blood, cloud}, wakes_on_hit / then_status, needs_first, blocked_by, ends, blocks, counts_as, flees (source | zone), blinded {sight, melee_reach}, lighter_class, reach_mult, floor_health / kneels_below, no_heal, freezes, control (a hold: a ticking payload applies it at most once per target per cast), heavy_lasts_mult, elite_status, derived (below_half: Dying; above_half: Hale - never applied, read from health), alias_of, shatter, light_radius, retch_every / retch_s, ends_after_damage, makes_interruptible, staggers_in_windup, lure_radius, cap_raise, shove_mult, ends_on_shove, goes_to_goal, hidden (not drawn). desc is one plain line for the player (skill_tables.STATUS_DESC); the rules line under it is made from these keys by StatusText (game/scripts/ui/status_text.gd). Merged duplicates: blinded - one status for fire (Flashpan), light (Hard Glare), dark (Pall) and ice (Whiteout, Snow): cannot see past 2 m, ranged enemies cannot aim, melee only lands within 1.5 m in front; unseen - one player rule for dark (standing in Dark: unseen beyond 4 m) and light (Bent Light: unseen beyond 3 m); an enemy that cannot see you cannot aim at you or close on you; rooted / pinned - rooted is an alias of pinned: one hold (40% speed, 2 s unless the skill says otherwise); hex / smite / seize / gaze - one kind, 'smite': an instant effect on the targeted enemy (gaze adds Dream's sight check); field_pulse - one kind shared by Death (corpses) and Nature (growth patches).

soaked.label: Soaked
soaked.desc: Wet through: your shoves throw it half again as far, and a Live mark on it leaps to every other Soaked enemy close by.

live.label: Live
live.desc: Charged with your lightning. Each hit adds a mark; the third Overloads it - a heavy blow and a stun, and an arc to every other marked enemy near it.

stunned.label: Stunned
stunned.desc: Knocked senseless: it cannot move or act, and whatever it was winding up is lost.

staggered.label: Staggered
staggered.desc: Its poise broken and off its feet: it does nothing and takes more from every hit - the moment for a bare strike.

alight.label: Alight
alight.desc: Burning in your name, harder with every stack. It catches on anyone who stands beside it, and jumps to a neighbour when it dies.

aloft.label: Aloft
aloft.desc: Thrown into the air: helpless until it lands, and taking more from every hit. One too heavy to lift loses its footing instead.

frenzied.label: Frenzied
frenzied.desc: Whipped up by a Censer-Bearer: it moves and attacks faster.

drummed.label: Drummed
drummed.desc: Steadied by a Drummer's beat: it attacks faster and is harder to stagger.

roused.label: Roused
roused.desc: Singled out by a Drummer: its next blow lands heavy, whoever throws it.

dazed.label: Dazed
dazed.desc: Reeling: it takes half again as much from every hit. A Dazed enemy can be put to sleep.

silenced.label: Silenced
silenced.desc: Cut off by an interrupt at full strength: it cannot start an attack or call for help.

pinned.label: Pinned
pinned.desc: Held fast - by roots, settling silt or a downdraft: it can barely move.

mired.label: Mired
mired.desc: Wading through mud or standing water: it moves more slowly while it stays in it.

chilled.label: Chilled
chilled.desc: Cold in its joints: slower with every stack. At five it freezes solid; an elite only turns Brittle.

frozen.label: Frozen
frozen.desc: Frozen solid: it cannot move or act and most of a blow glances off - but a hard hit Shatters it. It thaws still Chilled.

brittle.label: Brittle
brittle.desc: Cracked through: its next hard hit Shatters it, for heavy damage, and throws frozen shards at those beside it.

blinded.label: Blinded
blinded.desc: It cannot see past a couple of metres: it cannot aim at you, and its swings only land close in front of it.

lit.label: Lit
lit.desc: Picked out in light: the gaps in its armour show, so its guard stops half as much, and it gives off light. Light breaks a mask.

exposed.label: Exposed
exposed.desc: Outlined and open: every hit on it counts as from behind, and its shield does not help.

shadowbound.label: Shadowbound
shadowbound.desc: Its shadow nailed to the floor: it cannot walk, and nothing can shove or drag it - but it can still turn and swing.

rusting.label: Rusting
rusting.desc: Rust eats the metal it wears: damage every second for each class of metal, and its armour is halved. Bare skin does not care.

fused.label: Fused
fused.desc: Welded down: it moves much more slowly.

shackled.label: Shackled
shackled.desc: Its arms banded in iron: it can still walk, but cannot attack.

stripped.label: Stripped
stripped.desc: Its armour wrenched off: no front guard, it takes more from everything, and it no longer counts as armoured.

dulled.label: Dulled
dulled.desc: Every edge it carries blunted: its blows do less and cannot stagger you.

bleeding.label: Bleeding
bleeding.desc: Cut and bleeding, faster while it moves or swings. It drips blood pools as it goes, and dying leaves a pool and held blood for you.

sluggish.label: Sluggish
sluggish.desc: Its heart slowed: it moves slower, takes longer to wind up its attacks, and bleeds more slowly.

choked.label: Choked
choked.desc: Its own blood knotted in its throat: it cannot attack or call for help, and walks at half speed.

withering.label: Withering
withering.desc: Its own life turned against it: damage every second, straight past shields and armour. Only the living wither.

spent.label: Spent
spent.desc: Worn out: it moves and attacks more slowly. Only the living tire.

wasted.label: Wasted
wasted.desc: Its body wasting: its blows do less and its poise is cut, so it staggers sooner. Only the living.

sick.label: Sick
sick.desc: Sick to its stomach: every few seconds it retches, loses whatever it was doing and stands still.

arrested.label: Arrested
arrested.desc: Its body stopped mid-change: it cannot heal, its poise does not come back, and the Life statuses on it stop running down.

hale.label: Hale
hale.desc: Above half its health. Never put on anyone - read from its health; Life hits the Hale harder.

dying.label: Dying
dying.desc: Below half its health. Never put on anyone - read from its health; Death hits the Dying harder.

spared.label: Spared
spared.desc: Held back from death: nothing can bring it below 1 health, and below half health it kneels and does nothing.

rotting.label: Rotting
rotting.desc: Decay in its gear and flesh: its armour and shield count for half, and lost poise does not come back.

dread.label: Dread
dread.desc: A shade's dread: it backs away from the haunted ground and will not attack while it does.

dwindled.label: Dwindled
dwindled.desc: Shrunk by a gall-vine: it counts one weight class lighter - shoves throw it further, Aloft can lift it - and its reach is cut.

blighted.label: Blighted
blighted.desc: The wood it carries rots: its shield stops half as much, its attacks take longer to wind up, and Nature hits it harder.

asleep.label: Asleep
asleep.desc: Asleep on its feet: it does nothing until a hit wakes it. A first Dream spell only Dazes; a second puts the Dazed one under.

wakeful.label: Wakeful
wakeful.desc: Just woken: it cannot be put to sleep again yet - a sleep only Dazes it.

terrified.label: Terrified
terrified.desc: Terrified of you: it turns and runs from you and will not attack.

soothed.label: Soothed
soothed.desc: Hushed: it moves slower and starts no attacks. A hit snaps it out.

masked.label: Masked
masked.desc: It wears your face: its friends close by take it for you and go for it instead of you. It does not fight back.

read.label: Read
read.desc: You have read its tell: every attack it starts can be interrupted, and a hit during its wind-up staggers it.

commanded.label: Commanded
commanded.desc: Sent on an errand: it walks to the spot you chose and stands there, starting nothing. A hit breaks it.

shut.label: Shut
shut.desc: Its mind closed up: no Drummer can steady or rouse it, and it cannot call for help.

dosed.label: Dosed
dosed.desc: Poison on a clock: when the clock over its head runs out, every dose in it is paid at once. More doses add to the bill, not the time.

corroded.label: Corroded
corroded.desc: Acid eating its armour: each stack takes a third off its armour and shield and bares more of its flesh.

sapped.label: Sapped
sapped.desc: A thread of poison drains it: it deals less damage and moves slower while the thread holds.

infected.label: Infected
infected.desc: Sick with your disease, harder with every stack; armour keeps part of it out. Dying, it leaves a cloud that infects whoever walks in.

contained.label: Contained
contained.desc: Its sickness sealed in: Infected on it climbs higher and burns harder, but nothing spreads from it, alive or dead.

festering.label: Festering
festering.desc: A festering wound: its poise does not come back while it lasts.

waterlogged.label: Waterlogged
waterlogged.desc: Heavy with water: it counts as Soaked, and as one weight class lighter, so a shove throws a heavy enemy as if it were light.

drowning.label: Drowning
drowning.desc: Water closed over its head: it cannot attack or call for help, and takes damage until the water lets go or it has taken enough.

dripping.label: Dripping
dripping.desc: It drips: every second it is nudged a little away from you and loses some poise, and its poise does not recover.

adrift.label: Adrift
adrift.desc: Just moved by your water (not shown on it): Siltfall settles whatever is still Adrift.

seeped.label: Seeped
seeped.desc: Water under its guard: its shield and armour count for nothing, against anyone.

stilled.label: Stilled
stilled.desc: The tide hangs still: it moves slowly, and the next shove or drag on it goes twice as far - once.

insulated.label: Insulated
insulated.desc: Sealed under still air: Live marks do not leap into or out of it, no Drummer or Censer can work it up, and nothing bursts or spreads from it when it dies.

muted.label: Muted
muted.desc: A hum in its ears: it cannot drum or call for help.

buried.label: Buried
buried.desc: Heaped over with earth: it cannot move or act, and takes only a quarter of every hit. An elite is only Pinned.

taunted.label: Taunted
taunted.desc: Called out: it comes for whoever taunted it and attacks only them - an archer or a drummer walks in to fight hand to hand, and no lure, decoy or thrall draws it off.

turned.label: Turned
turned.desc: Spun round: it faces away from you, so every hit on it counts as from behind until it turns back.

tithed.label: Tithed
tithed.desc: Its life is tithed to you: every hit you land on it heals you a share of the harm. Only the living.

bidden.label: Bidden
bidden.desc: Marked for your dead: every thrall of yours goes for it, hitting it harder and faster.

quarry.label: Quarry
quarry.desc: Marked as the pack's quarry: your summons switch to it and hit it harder.

charmed.label: Charmed
charmed.desc: Charmed: it fights for you, going for the nearest of its old friends, and they turn on it. Hit it yourself and it snaps out.

doubting.label: Doubting
doubting.desc: Full of doubt: it is slow to start its attacks and its blows land half-hearted. Even an elite feels it, for a while.

steeped.label: Steeped
steeped.desc: The poison has steeped in: its dose clock runs a little longer, once, and the bill it pays is half again as big.

barbed.label: Barbed
barbed.desc: A barb in the flesh: every so often it works in another dose of your poison. Pulled when the doses are spent.

condemned.label: Condemned
condemned.desc: Judged and shown: it counts as Lit, its guard stops half as much, and every hit on it from you or yours adds to your ward.

penitent.label: Penitent
penitent.desc: Made to pay for its own violence: every attack it starts hurts it, and its blows on you and yours land softer.

exiled.label: Exiled
exiled.desc: Cast out: it will not come near whoever exiled it, and backs away if it is close - though it may still shoot. Elites only stagger back.

leeched.label: Leeched
leeched.desc: Leeched: every hit you land on it drains a share of the harm back to you as health.

leashed.label: Leashed
leashed.desc: On a short leash from whoever cast it: it cannot go further from them than the leash allows, though it can still shoot from inside it.

tormented.label: Tormented
tormented.desc: Kept failing on purpose: it hurts every second, and half of every hurt feeds whoever torments it. Its poise does not come back. Only the living.

stasis.label: Stasis
stasis.desc: Held outside time: it cannot act, and nothing on it runs down while it lasts. It comes out Stilled. An elite is only Stilled.

quickened.label: Quickened
quickened.desc: Quickened: you move faster and recover from each cast sooner.

vanished.label: Vanished
vanished.desc: Vanished: no enemy can see you, wherever you stand. Your next hit ends it - and is an Ambush.

ward.label: Ward
ward.desc: Ward: a guard over your body that takes blows before your health does. A blow it wholly stops opens no wound. Every ward fills the one pool, up to its cap, and each amount fades on its own clock.

in_the_green.label: In the Green
in_the_green.desc: In the Green: standing on your own growth, you and your beasts regrow health, are hard to shove and lose less poise.

red_frenzy.label: Red Frenzy
red_frenzy.desc: Red Frenzy: you strike faster and harder, move faster and keep your footing - and after a few seconds it drinks your held blood. When the blood runs out it ends.

blessed.label: Blessed
blessed.desc: Blessed: you and your summons near you hit harder, lose less poise, and your strikes leave enemies Lit.

absolved.label: Absolved
absolved.desc: Absolved: the next hold that would land on you is turned away.

kind_light.label: Kind Light
kind_light.desc: Kind Light: blows on you are softened, and what was taken off them comes back to you as health when it ends.

overgrown.label: Overgrown
overgrown.desc: Overgrown: you and your beasts hit harder, lose less poise, and every hit regrows a little health.

unleashed.label: Unleashed
unleashed.desc: Unleashed: a summon let off the leash - it hits harder and faster for a while.
